segments.text: to support the fundamentals of subscription and to make that business Central sales conversation easier we have added a new subscription billing feature set it gives you the tools to manage subscriptions ensuring contracts are properly documented manage with the correct term for the services billing frequency renewals terms and termination conditions allowing

you to run the recurring billing process in a way that can be adapted to your billing Rhythm and get subscription build on time of course it also allows you to recognize subscription Revenue that follows your reporting Cadence in

finance subscription billing enables you to run usage based billing for your subscriptions by importing quantities and prices for the recurring billing process in a. CSV file or a custom API subscription billing is part of the essential business Central license
